exposure: conization (LEEP vs. LLETZ) for cervical dysplasia
outcome: preterm prelabour rupture of membranes (PPROM) rate
cohort: 53 women who underwent conization for cervical dysplasia between 2007 and 2014 and subsequently became pregnant, compared to a control group of 100 pregnant women without a history of conization.
finding: Women with a history of conization for cervical dysplasia had higher rates of preterm delivery and PPROM compared to women without conization.
mod_finding: Women who underwent LEEP had higher rates of preterm delivery and PPROM compared to women who underwent LLETZ.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was not significantly different between the conization and control groups.
